scope: Actual locked local Apple M4 Pro phase1: text4 and VL4, code/prose text requests, exact256-token solo/four-stream decode, cold2048/8192 with16 outputs. No performance gate pass.

standard.dependency_provenance: Core source/MLX pins match prior standard procedure. Other dependencies are newly resolved and fully frozen; not asserted identical to the old M5 environment.
standard.memory_policy: Unmodified MLX defaults; no memory/wired limit overrides.
standard.context_policy: Pinned --max-kv-size70000 sets request budget; LFM3 family cache construction remains lazy and is not claimed allocation-identical to native.

guard_source.change: admission allows only owned descendants while a measured server is running; recognizes frozen binary names

protocol.admission: Exclusive flock held throughout model inventory, all twelve sequential owned server legs, measurement and cleanup. Process admission rejects foreign model jobs; only owned server process groups are cleaned up.
protocol.memory_policy: Native admission unchanged; MLX memory and wired limits unmodified. /usr/bin/time -l captures physical footprint and RSS; available server metrics preserved. No allocator/pinned peak inferred from RSS.
protocol.replay_requirements: Original frozen packet and artifacts are local retained inputs, not bundled executable tooling in this receipt. Set REPO/MODELS/PACKET paths appropriately; output must not exist. Packet validates pinned dependencies, binaries, client/fixture and model files before load. Reconstruct from the hashes/versions/commands here if the retained packet is unavailable.

limitations: Standard omits token hashes: alone/serial token equality unverified; output text digests are not substituted.
Both engines use request budget70000, but native reserved cache and standard lazy KV/sliding cache allocation differ.
Frozen public21728/ad3 baseline versus qualified combinedad72; later public builds are not substituted.
No6/8bit or32k/64k measurements in this phase.
Code/prose request workload for VL model is text-only; image correctness is separate qualified evidence.
Public text prose reverse leg drifted from183.7 to156.7solo and393.1 to333.2four-stream; retain per-leg spread. No thermal, frequency or bandwidth counter attribution.
The combined binary is the frozen qualified branchless+postnorm candidate; later applied-public binaries are not substituted.
Standard request body model IDs differ from native aliases, so request-body hashes differ even for the same pinned message fixture.
Standard8k text cold generated a different output digest from native; timing evidence is not a whole-model fidelity proof.
Peak physical footprint is the actual /usr/bin/time -l process measurement, not a claimed GPU allocator or pinned-memory peak.
raw_retention: Raw client/server logs, health/metrics/settings captures, manifest, events and records remain in local OUTPUT. This receipt includes their hashes rather than copying large token timestamp arrays or unrelated model catalog entries.
